items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chuck Suber has been a friend along the line.

ctx.x: Charles Suber, who used to be the publisher of Down Beat magazine for many years.

Chuck Suber was a facilitator, somebody who helped my career get along. He was somebody, as [the] publisher of Down Beat [magazine], who was in my corner from the very beginning. He taught me a very valuable lesson. He judged the first contests that I was in as a student at [the] Notre Dame Jazz Fest [Notre Dame Jazz Festival] and also wrote about me. I remember him stopping me one day, and he said, “Do you ever stop to say ‘thank you’ to people when they do something for you?” He said, “Keep it in mind. That…
And actually music, too. I think some of your music was published by Down Beat as well.
